Claim 1 (Currently amended): An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the alignment device is configured to utilize a combination of user input and sensor data to enhance the accuracy of the alignment.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment and further utilizes feedback from the user interface to refine the identification.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting is based on user interaction data.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification, wherein the highlighting is responsive to user actions.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and further incorporates user feedback to adjust the identified next step.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting is adjusted based on user interactions.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification, wherein the highlighting is influenced by user feedback.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, and incorporates real-time user input to refine the alignment.

Claim 12 (Currently amended): The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps, wherein the extraction is based on user interactions with the documented procedure.

Claim 18 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and utilizing user feedback to enhance the identification process.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The method of claim 18, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting is based on user interaction data.

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and incorporating user feedback to adjust the identified next step.

Claim 21 (Currently amended): The method of claim 20, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting is adjusted based on user interactions.
